# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 22 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Font size — 12 tokens; Size — 12 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--cl-canvas, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--cl-canvas` | #ffffff | 본문 바탕, 카드 · 메뉴 · 대화상자 바탕, 선택된 사이드바 메뉴 바탕. |
| `--cl-surface-dark` | #1d1d1f | 어두운 면(공개 영역). 작업공간 화면에서는 아직 쓰지 않는다. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 24px/1.35 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-page-title); letter-spacing: -0.025em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/PretendardVariable.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/PretendardVariable.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/PretendardVariable.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pretendard Variable | `fonts/PretendardVariable.woff2` (weight 45 920) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `pretendard-variable` |

### 공개 화면 글자 단계 (2026.10.27)

학원 메인 · 전체강좌 · 강좌 상세에 맞춘 역할별 단계. 공개 화면(학원소개 · 선생님소개 · Q&A · 자유게시판 …)은 새 크기를 만들지 않고 이 여섯 칸만 쓴다. 공개 화면도 작업공간과 같이 `--cl-fs-ui` 14 · `--cl-fs-caption` 13 으로 올린다(`.cl-scope.cl-pub-body`).

| 역할 | 토큰 | 크기 | 굵기 | 예 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 화면 제목 | `--cl-fs-display` | 40 · 모바일 28 | 700 | 전체강좌, 강좌 이름 |
| 섹션 제목 | `--cl-fs-section-pub` | clamp(26, 2.2vw, 32) | 700 | 대표 강좌, 분류별로 찾기 |
| 본문 · 목록 제목 · 탭 · 메뉴 | `--cl-fs-body-public` | 17 | 400 본문 / 600 제목 · 탭 | 강좌 설명, 강의 제목, 커리큘럼 탭 |
| 부제 · 필터 항목 | `--cl-fs-body-sm-pub` | 15 | 400 | 화면 부제, 대분류 · 과목 |
| 버튼 · 도구 · 정보 | `--cl-fs-ui` | 14 | 500 버튼 / 400 | 관련질문 · 공유하기, 정렬, 강사 · 학기 |
| 메타 · 위치 · 개수 | `--cl-fs-caption` | 13 | 400 | 홈 › 전체강좌, 2026.10.20 · 조회 0, 필터 제목 |

굵기는 세 단계만 쓴다 — 700 제목급, 600 누르는 제목 · 탭 · 값, 500 버튼. 나머지 400.

## Spacing

4px 단위 8단계. 실제 CSS는 아직 이 토큰보다 숫자를 직접 적은 곳이 많다(audit 4).

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--cl-space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `--cl-space-4` | 16px | 카드 안쪽 여백, 카드 사이, 모바일 화면 좌우 여백. |

## Size

높이 · 너비 고정값.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--cl-h-ws-topbar: 56px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--cl-h-ws-topbar), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```
